work_order.understanding: Issue #60 holds two QA follow-ups from PR #56 and says to re-check each before planning. Both were MEASURED in headless Chromium at 375x812 against a production build of current main (47b6b90), served on a spare port from a scratch copy of the repo. Item 2 REPRODUCES: after signing up, creating a group, adding a placeholder seat named 'z' x 80 on the members page and adding a 120 equal-split expense paid by the viewer, /groups/<id> reads documentElement.scrollWidth 740 vs clientWidth 375 (QA's 753 differs only by font/OS metrics); the only element whose right edge exceeds the viewport inside the card is the transfer row's name span (class `text-body text-lent`, right edge 739.9px; the other two elements past 376 are the tab strip's `li.shrink-0`/`a`, which sit in a horizontally scrolling strip and do not set the document width). Applying `min-w-0 break-words` to that span and `ml-auto` to the amount span in the live DOM brings the same page to 375 vs 375, and the screenshot shows the name wrapped over three lines inside the card with the amount '₹60.00' right-aligned beneath it. Item 1 does NOT reproduce: on the same build at 375px, with the owner's remove confirm expanded on the members page, scrollWidth is 375 vs 375 for a short seat ('Bo') and for an 80-char seat alike, and the screenshot shows the panel floating over the rows below with the question wrapping and naming member and group in full. The ticket's 'in-flow w-64' describes the build before #56's final round: components/groups-panels.tsx:692 now renders the panel as `absolute right-0 z-40 mt-2 w-64 max-w-[calc(100vw-3rem)]` inside `details.relative.shrink-0`, asserted by app/overflow-wrap.test.ts. Item 1 is dropped. Source for item 2: app/groups/[id]/page.tsx:546-550 renders `transferWords(transfer, membership.id)` ('<80 z's> owes you') in a span with no wrap treatment inside `li.flex.flex-wrap.items-baseline.justify-between`; transferWords is defined at :1040 and called only at :549.
work_order.root_cause: The name span in the summary card's transfer row is a flex item whose automatic minimum width equals its min-content (the whole unbroken 80-character name); overflow-wrap cannot lower that floor, so the row, the Card and the document grow past the viewport.
work_order.approach: One-element class fix. On the name span add `min-w-0 break-words`: the long name's max-content exceeds the container so it takes its own line of the flex-wrap row, flex-shrink then shrinks it to the container because its min-width is 0, and break-words breaks the unbroken name inside it. `min-w-0` is required because overflow-wrap alone does not reduce a flex item's automatic minimum size (conventions.md). On the amount span add `ml-auto` so that when the name takes a line to itself the amount sits right-aligned beneath it, as ui.md requires for amounts in lists (justify-between leaves a lone item flush left); with the name and amount on one line ml-auto is a no-op. Short names render identically. Sentences wrap rather than truncate (conventions.md: only list rows truncate), so the direction words stay readable. No shared component changes. The exact class set was verified in the live DOM before planning (740 -> 375, see understanding), so the fix is not a guess. Add a source-level regression test next to the page (the page is an async Server Component starting with a session read, so nothing renders it; amounts-tabular.test.ts is the precedent and documents the limit) and state plainly that pixel width is proven only by the browser AC. Item 1 is dropped on the measurement above; AC-5 has QA re-confirm it on a verified-current build.

Leave the li and everything else untouched. Optionally a one-line comment: min-w-0 because overflow-wrap cannot lower a flex item's automatic min-content size; ml-auto keeps the amount right when the name takes the line.

issue_snapshot.title: Follow-ups from #55: 2 from QA
issue_snapshot.body:
What the review and QA of PR #56 (for #55) found and did not fix there — filed as it merged, one ticket for the lot. ## Found by QA — pre-existing PR #56 did not introduce these, which is why they did not block it. ### Remove-member confirm open widens members page past 375px viewport **Severity** minor (as judged by QA — reassess before planning). **Expected.** > With the remove confirm expanded on the members page, the page fits the 375px viewport (scrollWidth <= clientWidth) while the question names its member and group in full. **Actual.** > With the remove confirm expanded, documentElement.scrollWidth reads 390 against clientWidth 375 — with 80-character names (T-3) and with short names (T-14) alike. The confirm question itself wraps correctly; the row around it does not fit: the confirm renders as an in-flow w-64 (256px, shrink-0) dropdown inside the member row, and 256px of dropdown plus avatar plus gaps exceeds the ~309px card content width, so the row pushes the document ~15px past the viewport until Cancel. **Steps to reproduce** 1. Sign up a fresh account and create any group (short names reproduce it; 80-char names are not required). 2. Add any placeholder seat from the members page. 3. Open the seat row overflow menu and press Remove to expand the confirm. 4. Read document.documentElement.scrollWidth vs clientWidth at a 375px viewport: 390 vs 375. **Suspected cause.** > Row geometry untouched by this PR: MemberRow renders the confirm in a div.mt-2.w-64.max-w-[calc(100vw-3rem)] inside details.relative.shrink-0 (components/groups-panels.tsx MemberRow), so the 256px dropdown cannot shrink inside the ~309px Card content width (Card p-4 inside main px-4 at 375px). The PR diff adds only break-words to the shared question

and never touches MemberRow (verified: the groups-panels.tsx hunk touches ClaimSeatForm/JoinPanel only); the T-14 short-name control overflows identically, so the defect predates the PR. The fix belongs with the row (e.g. an overlay dropdown or a narrower panel), not with the wrapping classes. **Reproducible:** always ### Group page balance row with an 80-character seat name widens the page to 753px at 375px **Severity** minor (as judged by QA — reassess before planning). **Expected.** > The group page fits a 375px viewport (scrollWidth <= clientWidth) when a member with an 80-character unbroken name owes money. **Actual.** > document scrollWidth is 753 vs clientWidth 375: the " owes you ₹60.00" row (li.flex.flex-wrap > span.text-body.text-lent in the balances section) has no overflow-wrap treatment. **Steps to reproduce** 1. Sign up and create any group. 2. On the members page add a seat named "z" repeated 80 times. 3. Add an expense of 120 split equally (paid by you). 4. Open /groups/ at a 375px viewport and read document.documentElement.scrollWidth: 753. **Suspected cause.** > app/groups/[id]/page.tsx balance list renders the member name in a span.text-body without break-words/min-w-0; the PR diff does not touch that file (same shape as the spots the PR fixes elsewhere). **Reproducible:** always --- **Check each one still reproduces before planning it.** They were written against the PR as it stood, and a later round can have fixed one. Some may not hold up: say so and drop them rather than implementing something that was never wrong. Split this if they turn out to be unrelated. Depends on #55.
